title: 'Trigger cannot be handled when processing an incomplete execution' warning on polling scenarios
symptoms: Email subject: Encountered warnings in scenario
Trigger cannot be handled when processing an incomplete execution
Several unrelated scenarios warn within the same minute
cause: A scheduled tick tried to start while the previous run was still finishing, so Make skipped that one cycle. The warning run uses 1 operation and 0 transfer and touches no data. The trigger resumes from the same position on the next cycle.
fix: Take no action when the scenario has no incomplete executions, is not waiting, is active and has nextExec set. Do not deactivate and reactivate: on a polling trigger that can reset its position and skip real items. Act only if the warning turns daily or incomplete executions start to pile up.
apply: GET /api/v2/scenarios/{id}: expect dlqCount 0, iswaiting false, isActive true, nextExec set.
